about.title: An identity that speaks before she has to explain.
about.text: Visual identity and institutional landing page, focused on strengthening Thayná Aguiar's digital positioning.

client.title: About the project.
client.p1: Copywriter from Recife, passionate about football and the digital world. <client>Thayná Aguiar</client> is a specialist in creating content that makes a difference on social media. She turns brands into stories that connect people, engage and convert.
client.p2: Thayná already knew who she was. She needed an identity that said it before she had to explain.
client.p3: We started from the concept she brought and expanded it into a website, social media creatives and a media kit. Every visual choice had a reason.

goals.title: What needed to be solved.
items: Create an identity that represents her faithfully
Build a website that generates trust and contact
Structure replicable creatives for social media
Deliver a media kit ready for professional use
Ensure consistent performance on desktop and mobile
goals.p1: The identity had to convey authority without losing human warmth. The interface had to be light enough not to compete for attention with what she communicates.
goals.p2: The visual direction was clear: less decoration, more intention. Strong typography, breathing room and subtle micro-interactions.

mediaKit.title: Graphic material for the project.
mediaKit.text: The media kit gathers the numbers, links and visual material Thayná uses to present herself to brands and partners.

develop.title: React + Tailwind. Hosted on Cloudflare.
develop.text: The site was built in React with Tailwind and hosted on Cloudflare, focused on performance, fluidity and scalability.
